identity.name: IronPop Gym
identity.one_line_description: IronPop Gym is a strength training gym with a bold, energetic personality that helps everyday people build serious muscle through structured programs, expert coaching, and a community that celebrates every rep.
identity.target_audience: Adults aged 18–40 who are new to or progressing in strength training, want structured programming over random workouts, and are drawn to a gym culture that is fun, loud, and unapologetically motivating.

pages.title: Home
pages.goal: Instantly communicate IronPop's bold identity, make visitors feel the energy of the gym, and push them toward exploring programs or booking a first session.
pages.meta_description: IronPop Gym — a strength training gym where bold programming, expert coaching, and a wildly fun community help you lift more and live louder.

sections.intent: Grab attention immediately with IronPop's loud personality and make the core value proposition crystal clear: this is a strength gym that is both serious about results and genuinely fun.
sections.headline: Lift Bold. Live Loud.
sections.subheadline: IronPop is the strength gym for people who want real results without taking themselves too seriously. Pick up heavy things. Make friends. Repeat.

sections.intent: Quickly communicate the three pillars that make IronPop different from a generic big-box gym, giving visitors a reason to stay and explore.
sections.headline: We're Not Your Average Gym
sections.subheadline: Three things that make members stay, lift, and come back for more.

items.title: Structured Strength Programs
items.description: No guesswork. Every session follows a proven strength plan — from beginner barbell basics to advanced powerlifting blocks.

items.title: Coaches Who Actually Coach
items.description: Our trainers are on the floor, not behind a desk. They watch your form, adjust your load, and celebrate your PRs like it's their own.

items.title: A Community That Hypes You Up
items.description: Whether it's your first deadlift or your hundredth, the IronPop crew is loud, supportive, and genuinely excited for your wins.

sections.intent: Close the home page with a punchy, low-friction invitation to take the first step, converting interest into a booked session.
sections.headline: Your First Session Is On Us
sections.subheadline: Come lift with us for free. No commitment, no awkward sales pitch — just a great workout and a community worth joining.

pages.title: Programs
pages.goal: Give visitors a clear, exciting overview of all training programs offered at IronPop so they can find the right fit and feel confident signing up.
pages.meta_description: Explore IronPop Gym's strength training programs — from beginner barbell fundamentals to powerlifting prep, there's a program built for every level.

sections.intent: Set the tone for the Programs page and reassure visitors that whatever their level, there is a program designed for them.
sections.headline: Find Your Program. Own Your Lift.
sections.subheadline: Every IronPop program is built around progressive overload, expert coaching, and a whole lot of fun. Pick your level and let's go.

sections.intent: Present each training program as its own card with enough detail for visitors to self-select the right fit, driving them toward booking.
sections.headline: Six Programs. One Goal: Getting Stronger.

items.title: Barbell Basics
items.description: The perfect starting point. Learn the squat, deadlift, bench, and overhead press with hands-on coaching in a small group setting. 8-week cycle.

items.title: Iron Foundation
items.description: Build a complete strength base with compound lifts, accessory work, and mobility drills. Designed for those past the basics and ready to load up.

items.title: Pop Powerlifting
items.description: A full powerlifting block with periodized programming, competition prep options, and weekly technique reviews. Squat. Bench. Deadlift. Dominate.

items.title: Strength & Conditioning
items.description: Combines heavy lifting with conditioning circuits for members who want to be strong and athletic. High energy, high output.

items.title: Open Barbell Club
items.description: Drop-in strength sessions with a coach on the floor. No fixed program — just structured open lifting time for members who know what they're doing.

items.title: 1-on-1 Coaching
items.description: Fully personalized programming and coaching tailored to your goals, schedule, and body. The fastest path to your strongest self.

sections.intent: Encourage visitors who are still deciding to take a low-risk first step by booking a free intro session rather than committing to a full program upfront.
sections.headline: Let a Coach Point You in the Right Direction
sections.subheadline: Book a free 30-minute intro session and we'll match you with the right program for your goals, experience, and schedule.

pages.title: Pricing
pages.goal: Present membership and program pricing in a clear, confident way that removes hesitation and motivates visitors to commit.
pages.meta_description: IronPop Gym membership and program pricing — transparent plans for every budget, with no hidden fees and a free first session to get you started.

sections.intent: Frame pricing as a straightforward, honest conversation — no tricks, no fine print — to build trust before visitors see the numbers.
sections.headline: Straight-Up Pricing. Zero Nonsense.
sections.subheadline: Pick the plan that fits your life. Every membership includes access to coached sessions, open gym, and the loudest community in town.

sections.intent: Display the three membership tiers clearly so visitors can quickly compare options and choose the one that matches their goals and budget.
sections.headline: Three Plans. All Gains.

items.title: Pop Starter
items.description: Perfect for beginners or those testing the waters. Includes 2 coached group sessions per week, open gym access, and access to the IronPop app.

items.title: Iron Member
items.description: Our most popular plan. Unlimited group sessions, open gym access, monthly program check-ins, and priority booking for specialty workshops.

items.title: Elite Lifter
items.description: Everything in Iron Member plus two 1-on-1 coaching sessions per month, personalized programming, and nutrition guidance from our certified coaches.

sections.intent: Address the most common pricing objections and questions to reduce friction and give visitors the confidence to sign up.
sections.headline: Got Questions? We've Got Answers.

items.title: Is there a joining fee?
items.description: Nope. No joining fee, no setup fee, no surprises. You pay your monthly rate and that's it.

items.title: Can I freeze or cancel my membership?
items.description: Yes. You can freeze your membership for up to 2 months per year and cancel with 30 days' notice — no questions asked.

items.title: Do programs cost extra?
items.description: Structured programs like Barbell Basics and Pop Powerlifting are included in all memberships. 1-on-1 coaching is available as an add-on or included in the Elite Lifter plan.

items.title: What does the free session include?
items.description: A 45-minute coached session, a tour of the gym, and a quick goal-setting chat with one of our coaches. No sales pressure — just lifting.

pages.title: Stories
pages.goal: Build trust and emotional connection by showcasing real member transformation stories, making prospective members see themselves in the IronPop community.
pages.meta_description: Real stories from real IronPop members — read how everyday people built strength, confidence, and community at IronPop Gym.

sections.intent: Set an inspiring, celebratory tone for the Stories page that signals these are real people with real results, not polished marketing fluff.
sections.headline: Real People. Real Reps. Real Results.
sections.subheadline: Every member at IronPop has a story worth telling. Here are a few of our favorites.

sections.intent: Feature a standout member testimonial as the anchor story on the page to immediately establish credibility and emotional resonance.
sections.headline: "IronPop Didn't Just Change My Body — It Changed How I See Myself."
sections.subheadline: — Maya R., Iron Member for 14 months
sections.body: Maya walked in knowing nothing about barbells and left her first session hooked. Fourteen months later, she's deadlifting twice her bodyweight, coaching newer members through their first lifts, and says IronPop is the first gym she's ever actually looked forward to going to.

sections.intent: Show a variety of member stories across different backgrounds, goals, and programs to help every type of visitor find someone they relate to.
sections.headline: Every Lift Has a Story Behind It

items.title: From Couch to Competition — Jordan T.
items.description: Jordan joined IronPop with zero gym experience and 18 months later competed in his first local powerlifting meet. His secret? Showing up three times a week and trusting the program.

items.title: Strength After 40 — Sandra K.
items.description: Sandra was told she was 'too old' to start lifting. She proved everyone wrong. Now 44, she's the strongest she's ever been and leads our Wednesday morning Open Barbell Club.

items.title: Building Confidence, One Rep at a Time — Carlos M.
items.description: Carlos struggled with gym anxiety for years. The small group format and supportive coaches at IronPop made him feel safe enough to push his limits for the first time.

items.title: An Athlete Rediscovered — Priya N.
items.description: A former college sprinter who had drifted from fitness for a decade, Priya found her competitive edge again through IronPop's Strength & Conditioning program.

ctas.label: Start Your Story — Book a Free Session

pages.title: Book
pages.goal: Convert interested visitors into booked sessions with a frictionless, reassuring booking experience that reinforces IronPop's welcoming personality.
pages.meta_description: Book your free intro session at IronPop Gym — no commitment, no pressure, just a great workout and a community ready to welcome you.

sections.intent: Welcome visitors to the booking page with energy and reassurance, making the act of booking feel exciting rather than intimidating.
sections.headline: Your First Rep Starts Here
sections.subheadline: Book your free 45-minute intro session. Show up, lift something, and see what all the noise is about.

sections.intent: Provide the actual booking form along with key session details so visitors have everything they need to commit and show up.
sections.headline: Pick a Time That Works for You
sections.subheadline: Sessions run Monday through Saturday. All fitness levels welcome — seriously, all of them.
sections.body: Fill out the form below and one of our coaches will confirm your session within a few hours. Come ready to move and we'll handle the rest.

items.title: What to Bring
items.description: Comfortable workout clothes, a water bottle, and an open mind. We provide all the equipment.

items.title: What to Expect
items.description: A warm welcome, a quick goals chat, a coached group warm-up, your first strength session, and a cool-down. 45 minutes total.

items.title: Where to Find Us
items.description: IronPop Gym, 214 Kettlebell Lane, Unit 4. Free parking on-site. Look for the big yellow sign.

sections.intent: Offer an alternative path for visitors who are not ready to book but want to learn more, keeping them engaged with the site.
sections.headline: Explore Programs First, Book When You're Ready
sections.subheadline: Take a look at what we offer, read some member stories, and come back when the time is right. We'll be here — probably deadlifting.
